title: Noon skein: runtime tasks & micro-hypotheses
content:
Context / vibe: quick mid-day capture before pairing with SRE. Not polished; scratchpad for things I want to act on or ask about in standup. Priorities: stop small p99 spikes, stabilize kv-prefetch heuristic, and validate rollback for last-night kernel patch (rWIP).

Top-of-mind goals (today):
- Verify INF-4721 repro on staging (latency spikes at seq_len=1024 on small batch sizes).
- Roll forward a kv-cache partial eviction toggle on canary (10% traffic) and watch p95/p99 for 30m.
- Finish micro-bench harness to reproduce LRU vs LFU when cache hit rate ~0.6.

Triage queue (ordered):
1) INF-4721: observed 20–40ms token p99 bump between 11:12–11:45 UTC. Repro steps documented in ticket. Quick hypothesis: kernel prefetch path + small batch jitter -> lock contention in kv-access. Need to confirm with perf counters.
   - Quick checks: run perf stat on canary node while replaying workload (use replay script: infra/tools/replay_kv.py --seed 42 --seq 1024 --clients 8).
   - Logs to grab: /var/log/redwood/runtime/kernel-prefetch.log.*, trace ids: 8a1f3c.. (from ticket)

2) INF-4699: function-calling stream stalls occasionally when model falls back to quantized variant. Probable cause: kernel kernel-switch path not clearing per-request scratch. Repro: small intermittent stalls on long chats (>8 messages).
   - Temp mitigation: pinned model variant for affected route; needs AB test to measure user-visible regressions.

Micro-hypotheses (fast experiments):
- H1: Eviction interval too aggressive for medium-rate workloads -> thrash -> latency blips. Quick test: double eviction interval on staging for 12h and measure p99. If p99 drops and hit-rate stable -> keep and tune.
- H2: CUDA stream re-use causing cross-request waits at high concurrency. Probe: instrument active cuda-stream count with a simple eBPF probe and compare during spike windows.

Planned commands / dashboards:
- Grafana: inference/runtime-p99-by-route (last 6h) + overlay canary vs baseline.
- Loki: {app="runtime", level="warn"} |~ "evict" | json | last 24h.
- Jaeger: search trace tag kv_cache_hit=false and duration > 200ms.

Quick repro steps (local):
1) Start tiny cluster: tools/cluster/start_local.sh --gpus 2 --workers 4
2) Build debug runtime: make -C runtime BUILD=debug && docker build -t local/runtime:dbg .
3) Run replay: infra/tools/replay_kv.py --target localhost:8080 --seed 42 --seq 1024 --clients 8 --duration 600
4) Tail logs: ./scripts/tail-logs.sh runtime kernel-prefetch | sed -n '1,200p'

Canary plan for kv-eviction toggle:
- Rollout: 0% -> 1% -> 10% (30m windows) -> 50% (1h) -> 100% if stable. Watchers: Ivy + Hector.
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99, cache_hit_rate, 99th CPU, kernel lock wait time (instrumented gauge).
- Abort criteria: p99 increases >10% vs baseline for two consecutive windows OR error rate >0.1% OR spike correlation with GC events.

Notes to ask in standup:
- Hector: can you add a temporary gauge for cuda stream count? I can add eBPF probes but need a quick metric inside runtime for at least 24h.
- Ivy: can you run the eviction-interval experiment on staging overnight and upload aggregated metrics CSV to INF-4721?
- Ops: who owns the canary routing config? Need manual control to push 10% quickly if test is green.

Loose ends / TODOs (personal):
- Write small doc summarizing difference between our LFU impl and the newer TinyLFU sketch. (15–30m)
- Add regression test in integration that simulates mixed-size prefix cache pressure. (30–60m)
- Follow up on PR 412 comments (two nits + one integration flake).

Misc brain dump (captured signals / weirds):
- Noticed repeated warning: "kv eviction delayed by gc pause" on node-12 at 03:02 UTC (maybe a cron job?). Add croncheck to node-runbook.
- Two nights ago we rolled kernel patch rWIP-3 which changed the allocation fastpath; rolling back for a short window last night seemed to reduce p99 by ~6% in canary. Need A/B to confirm tradeoffs.

End note: this doc is ephemeral. Will clean up into INF-4721 and create a short playbook if we confirm root cause. For now, actionables: repro INF-4721 on staging, toggle eviction for 10% canary, ask Hector about cuda metric.
